ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
summary: National campaign to address the declining child sex ratio and promote education and welfare of the girl child.
benefits: Community awareness, advocacy, and multi-sectoral action for girl-child survival, protection and education (not a direct cash-transfer scheme).
eligibility: Nationwide campaign — no individual application required for the awareness component
application_steps: Implemented through district-level task forces; individual welfare linkages via Anganwadi/health workers
